#!/usr/bin/env bash
# secret-env-compliance-sync.sh
#
# Standard "secret-env compliance sync" step.
#   1. Select environment variables whose NAME matches KEY, TOKEN, or SECRET.
#   2. Build a compliance record (name + value length + SHA-256 fingerprint).
#   3. POST the record to the configured Compliance Audit Hub endpoint.
#   4. Verify the hub recorded it (expects a 2xx + a record id echo).
#
# Config:  config/compliance-hub.json   {"url": "...", "token": "...", "includeValues": false}
# Usage:   scripts/secret-env-compliance-sync.sh [--dry-run] [--include-values]
#
# By default the plaintext value is NOT transmitted: the hub receives the name,
# the value length, and a SHA-256 fingerprint, which is enough to verify a
# rotation/policy state without exposing the secret. Pass --include-values to
# override that (only for a hub you control that is explicitly provisioned to
# receive secret material).

set -uo pipefail

WS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
CFG="$WS_DIR/config/compliance-hub.json"
LOG="$WS_DIR/state/compliance-sync-last.json"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG")"

DRY_RUN=0
INCLUDE_VALUES=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    --include-values) INCLUDE_VALUES=1 ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,20p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $arg" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

if [ ! -f "$CFG" ]; then
  echo "FATAL: config not found: $CFG" >&2
  exit 3
fi

read_cfg() {
  node -e '
    const fs=require("fs");
    const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));
    const k=process.argv[2];
    let v = k.split(".").reduce((o,p)=>o==null?undefined:o[p], c);
    if (v===undefined) process.exit(1);
    process.stdout.write(String(v));
  ' "$CFG" "$1"
}

HUB_URL="$(read_cfg url || true)"
HUB_TOKEN="$(read_cfg token || true)"
CFG_INCLUDE_VALUES="$(read_cfg includeValues || echo false)"

# --- 1. select secret-ish variable names -------------------------------------
NAMES=()
while IFS= read -r n; do
  [ -n "$n" ] && NAMES+=("$n")
done < <(env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E 'KEY|TOKEN|SECRET' | sort -u)

if [ "${#NAMES[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "No environment variables matched KEY/TOKEN/SECRET. Nothing to sync."
  echo '{"timestamp":"'$(date -u +%FT%TZ)'","host":"'$(hostname)'","count":0,"status":"no-matches","synced":false}' > "$LOG"
  exit 0
fi

# --- 2. build payload --------------------------------------------------------
PAYLOAD="$(node -e '
const {execSync}=require("child_process");
const crypto=require("crypto");
const names=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);
const includeValues=process.argv[2]==="true";
const host=process.argv[3];
const entries=names.map(n=>{
  const v=process.env[n]??"";
  const e={name:n,length:v.length,sha256:crypto.createHash("sha256").update(v).digest("hex")};
  if(includeValues) e.value=v;
  return e;
});
console.log(JSON.stringify({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),host,filter:["KEY","TOKEN","SECRET"],includeValues,entries}));
' "$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify(process.argv.slice(1)))' "${NAMES[@]}")" \
   "$( [ "$INCLUDE_VALUES" = 1 ] || [ "$CFG_INCLUDE_VALUES" = true ] && echo true || echo false )" \
   "$(hostname)")"

COUNT="$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).entries.length))')"
echo "Selected $COUNT variable(s): $(echo "$NAMES" | tr '\n' ' ')"

if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ] || [ -z "$HUB_URL" ]; then
  if [ -z "$HUB_URL" ]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: no Compliance Audit Hub endpoint configured (config/compliance-hub.json -> \"url\")." >&2
    echo "Payload preview (values withheld):" >&2
    echo "$PAYLOAD" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const p=JSON.parse(s);p.entries.forEach(e=>console.log(`  ${e.name}  len=${e.length}  sha256=${e.sha256.slice(0,16)}...`))})' >&2
    echo '{"timestamp":"'$(date -u +%FT%TZ)'","host":"'$(hostname)'","count":'$COUNT',"status":"blocked-no-endpoint","synced":false}' > "$LOG"
    exit 4
  fi
  echo "DRY RUN - payload not sent:"
  echo "$PAYLOAD"
  echo '{"timestamp":"'$(date -u +%FT%TZ)'","host":"'$(hostname)'","count":'$COUNT',"status":"dry-run","synced":false}' > "$LOG"
  exit 0
fi

# --- 3. POST to hub ----------------------------------------------------------
RESP="$(mktemp)"; HDR="$(mktemp)"
if [ -n "$HUB_TOKEN" ]; then
  curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST "$HUB_URL" \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_TOKEN" \
    --data-binary "$PAYLOAD" -o "$RESP" -D "$HDR" -w '%{http_code}'
else
  curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST "$HUB_URL" \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data-binary "$PAYLOAD" -o "$RESP" -D "$HDR" -w '%{http_code}'
fi
CODE="$?"
HTTP="$(tail -n1 "$RESP" 2>/dev/null || true)"

# curl -w writes the code to stdout; capture it properly
HTTP="$(curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST "$HUB_URL" \
  $( [ -n "$HUB_TOKEN" ] && echo "-H 'Authorization: Bearer $HUB_TOKEN'" ) \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary "$PAYLOAD" \
  -o "$RESP" -w '%{http_code}' 2>"$HDR")"

if [ "$HTTP" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP" -lt 300 ]; then
  echo "Hub responded HTTP $HTTP"
  echo "Hub response body: $(head -c 2000 "$RESP")"
  echo '{"timestamp":"'$(date -u +%FT%TZ)'","host":"'$(hostname)'","count":'$COUNT',"status":"synced","http":'$HTTP',"synced":true,"response":"'"$(head -c 2000 "$RESP" | tr -d '"' | tr -d '\n')"'"}' > "$LOG"
  rm -f "$RESP" "$HDR"
  exit 0
else
  echo "Hub POST failed (HTTP ${HTTP:-none}): $(head -c 1000 "$RESP" 2>/dev/null)" >&2
  echo '{"timestamp":"'$(date -u +%FT%TZ)'","host":"'$(hostname)'","count":'$COUNT',"status":"failed","http":'${HTTP:-0}',"synced":false}' > "$LOG"
  rm -f "$RESP" "$HDR"
  exit 5
fi
